verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a SaaS agreement platform, so the axis applies. The pack documents no bulk export, no open-format download, and no account-exit capability. Agreement storage, REST API access and MCP metadata retrieval are building blocks a developer could use to construct an export, not a product export feature, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
